feed.title: Google Cloud: App Engine flexible environment PHP
feed.subtitle: Changelog for Google Cloud product: App Engine flexible environment PHP

entry.content:
The following runtime language contains important security updates:

  • PHP 8.2 and later: 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27, 8.5.12

The following stacks and their underlying operating system packages have also been updated:

  • google-22, google-22-full
  • google-24, google-24-full

Take immediate protective action by rebuilding and redeploying your resources with updated dependencies.

See Security bulletins for Google Cloud for more information.
entry.summary: Important security updates are now available for PHP 8.2 and later, as well as updated stacks including google-22 and google-24. Rebuild and redeploy your resources to apply these critical security patches.
entry.title: Security: Runtime language security updates available

entry.content:
All supported versions of PHP 8.2 and later are patched. Take immediate protective action by redeploying your resources with updated dependencies.

See Responding to core PHP vulnerabilities for more information.
entry.summary: A critical security vulnerability has been identified in PHP. All supported versions of PHP 8.2 and later have been patched. Redeploy your resources with updated dependencies immediately to protect your applications.
entry.title: Security: Urgent PHP Security Update

entry.content:
This note is incorrect; follow guidance in the entry for October 22, 2026.

Patch updates to supported PHP runtimes are available with deployments from source: 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, and 8.2.35. Take immediate action to protect your PHP workloads by redeploying your workloads with updated dependencies. If you use custom runtimes, update your dependencies and redeploy. See Responding to core PHP vulnerabilities for more information.
entry.summary: Security vulnerabilities have been discovered in core PHP. Redeploy your PHP workloads immediately using updated runtimes (8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, 8.2.35) or update dependencies for custom runtimes to protect your applications.
entry.title: Security: Urgent PHP Runtime Update Required

entry.content: App Engine permanently blocks insecure traffic with TLS version 1.1 and earlier. For appspot.com domains, this block occurs at the connection level. For custom domains, the connection might succeed, but the requests are blocked. For more information, see Secure minimum TLS.
entry.summary: App Engine now enforces TLS 1.2 or later for all traffic, blocking older, insecure versions. This change applies to both appspot.com and custom domains to enhance security.
entry.title: Feature: App Engine ends support for older TLS versions

entry.content: Starting from August 2026, to provide modern security patches and support for MySQL 8.4 and later, the App Engine flexible environment uses Cloud SQL Auth Proxy v2 as the built-in sidecar container for connections to Cloud SQL. To use the latest Cloud SQL Auth Proxy container immediately, restart your VMs or deploy a new version of your application.
entry.summary: App Engine flexible environment is updating its connection to Cloud SQL with the Cloud SQL Auth Proxy v2, starting August 2026. This ensures modern security patches and support for MySQL 8.4 and later. You can enable the new proxy immediately by restarting your VMs or deploying a new application version.
entry.title: Feature: Updated Cloud SQL Auth Proxy for App Engine

entry.content: To improve security, starting in August 2026, App Engine opts your application into TLS version 1.2 and later. You can opt out until the end of August 2026. Starting in September 2026, App Engine might permanently block insecure traffic with TLS version 1.1 and earlier. For more information, see Secure minimum TLS.
entry.summary: To enhance security, App Engine will soon require TLS 1.2 or later for applications. You can opt out until August 2026, after which older TLS versions may be blocked to prevent insecure traffic.
entry.title: Feature: App Engine TLS Update

entry.content: Support for deploying your existing apps in the flexible environment to Cloud Run using the gcloud beta app migrate-to-run command is in Preview. For more information, see Deploy an App Engine app in the flexible environment to Cloud Run.
entry.summary: You can now migrate your App Engine flexible environment applications to Cloud Run using the `gcloud beta app migrate-to-run` command. This feature is in Preview and allows for easier deployment of existing apps to a more flexible environment. For detailed instructions, refer to the official documentation.
entry.title: Feature: Migrate App Engine flexible to Cloud Run

entry.content: Support for the PHP 8.5 runtime is in General Availability.
entry.summary: The PHP 8.5 runtime is now generally available. This new runtime offers enhanced features and performance for your PHP applications.
entry.title: Feature: PHP 8.5 runtime now generally available

entry.summary: The PHP 8.5 runtime is now available in preview for App Engine flexible environment. This update brings the latest features and improvements of PHP 8.5 to your applications. We encourage you to try it out and provide feedback during this preview period.
entry.title: Feature: PHP 8.5 runtime now in preview

entry.content: Support for TLS version 1.2 and later, along with a corresponding secure set of cipher suites, is in General Availability (GA).
entry.summary: We're happy to announce that support for TLS 1.2 and later is now in General Availability. This update also includes a secure set of cipher suites.
entry.title: Feature: TLS 1.2 Support Now Available

entry.content: To increase security, starting in March 2025, support for Transport Layer Security (TLS) version 1.1 and earlier is deprecated. Update your application settings in the App Engine flexible environment to use TLS version 1.2 and later, along with a corresponding secure set of cipher suites (Preview).
entry.summary: Support for TLS 1.1 and earlier is deprecated starting March 2025. Update your App Engine settings to use TLS 1.2 or later.
entry.title: Feature: TLS Support Update

entry.content: Support for the PHP 8.4 runtime is in General Availability (GA).
entry.summary: We are pleased to announce that PHP 8.4 is now generally available for the App Engine flexible environment. This update provides the latest features and improvements for your PHP applications.
entry.title: Feature: PHP 8.4 Runtime Now Available
